metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: HOYMER crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C144 H148 N18 Ni16 O64 S16 Tb6,8(C1 H4 O1),5(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Tb1 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb2 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb2A (Tb) has 6 O neighbors; Tb3 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb3A (Tb) has 5 O neighbors; Ni1 (Ni) has 4 O neighbors; Ni2 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3 (Ni) has 4 O neighbors; Ni4 (Ni) has 4 O neighbors; Ni5 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni6 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni7 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni8 (Ni) has 4 O neighbors; Tb6 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb7 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb9 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Ni9 (Ni) has 4 O neighbors; Ni10 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni11 (Ni) has 4 O neighbors; Ni12 (Ni) has 4 O neighbors; Ni13 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni14 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni15 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni16 (Ni) has 4 O neighbors; Tb8 (Tb) has 6 O neighbors; Tb10 (Tb) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 61 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 1.079-4.926 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 17.86-136.25°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Ni16Tb6(μ3-OH)24(mmt)8(Hdpga)4(dpga)4(CH3COO)2(NO3)4(H2O)2]·12CH3OH·5H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 24 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
